author: RightSide
body:
Well I was just thinking about what other people get with there internet . Please don't make it competitive ! Feel free to post like this :

1. Internet Download Speed : (56mb)
2. Ping For Avicus : (52ms)
3. In your opinion is your internet fast : (Yes)

I made this post just to find out what other people get .

HOW TO FIND OUT:

To find out what is your internet download speed visit :
http://www.speedtest.net/ and click Begin Test 

To find out your ping is for Avcius open up your Command Prompt or CMD and type in " ping avic.us " this is to find out your ping.
